tentative.title: 默认设施表的两处旧身份在当前目录与 Gen5 目录下产生不同编译结果，尚无具名向量
preconditions: Frozen default tower PBS and current root item/move identifiers; normal successful item/move compilation and list compilation, or compatible loaded registries with exactly these identities.
No plugin or supplemental root file defines STICK or VICEGRIP; no author modification of the table; all preceding parse dependencies succeed.
Gen5 comparison is explicit optional alternate registered catalogs, not automatic backup selection; no files are copied or compiled in this review.
Rewriting/instantiating results additionally requires successful respective consumer stages.
tentative.normal_control: The documented parser tolerates missing item identity as nil and skips missing move identities. With catalogs actually defining STICK/VICEGRIP (the Gen5 backup profile), these two fields survive the parser. Current-root LEEK/VISEGRIP are different identifiers; handlers mentioning both do not register data aliases.

minimal_counterexample.input: Default template index137 / PBS line140: FARFETCHD with STICK, RELAXED, three EV labels and SLASH/KNOCKOFF/SWORDSDANCE/AGILITY.
minimal_counterexample.current_root_expected: Species/nature/moves remain, item becomes nil; successful subsequent materialization has no held item; successful PBS rewrite emits an empty held-item field.
minimal_counterexample.gen5_registered_profile_expected: STICK resolves and the held-item identity is retained.

minimal_counterexample.input: Default template index249 / PBS line252: CRAWDAUNT with PERSIMBERRY, ADAMANT, HP/DEF/SD and BUBBLEBEAM/VICEGRIP/KNOCKOFF/PROTECT.
minimal_counterexample.current_root_expected: VICEGRIP is dropped and survivors compact to BUBBLEBEAM/KNOCKOFF/PROTECT. It is not automatically renamed VISEGRIP and no fallback move is inserted because three valid moves remain. Successful rewrite preserves three survivors and an empty fourth slot.
minimal_counterexample.gen5_registered_profile_expected: All four listed move identities survive.

necessary_consumers.role: List child files parsed into data
Generator and facility consume default table fallback
Successful later rewrite materializes field loss

negative_search.summary: Root PBS section membership and all scripts searched. No STICK or VICEGRIP data alias definition found. VICEGRIP has no script hit. STICK hits are handler compatibility or a move blacklist, not registry entries. Precompile rewriting only covers VictoryME/BaseDamage. Compiler discovery is root PBS/*.txt, not recursive backups. Entire formal set searched for both legacy spellings; no named template/vector exists.

tentative.impact: Generic parsing rule is already correct. Gap is concrete compatibility evidence for shipped default inputs: current-root compilation loses an item and a move which an explicitly selected Gen5 registry can retain. A clean-room test corpus may otherwise exercise only synthetic unknown identities and omit shipped cases. No claim that the entire generator/host fails.
tentative.minimal_fix: Append two implementation-independent named static vectors near WP76 §8.4 or its GN tests. State active-root registry precondition, nil item / compacted three moves, successful later rewrite conditions, and optional Gen5 alternate-ID contrast. Keep paths/lines in audit only. Do not edit reference data or add aliases to future behavior.
tentative.proposed_sanitized_text: 当前默认设施候选中的 FARFETCHD／STICK 与 CRAWDAUNT／VICEGRIP 是具名数据兼容对照。仅在采用当前根目录物品和招式目录、无额外身份定义且解析正常时：前者持物转空；后者跳过 VICEGRIP，剩余招式按原相对顺序成为 BUBBLEBEAM、KNOCKOFF、PROTECT，不自动改名为 VISEGRIP。后续创建或反写成功时分别消费该空持物与三招式结果。显式采用含 STICK／VICEGRIP 的 Gen5 身份目录时，两处身份可保留；备份不会因存在而自动进入当前目录。以上为静态推导，未执行编译、创建、对战、反写或完整 Demo。
tentative.preserved_scope: Preserve §8.4 generic invalid-item/invalid-move rule, source/destination ordering, nil-nature exception, checkpoints/default flag behavior and all existing GN/B17 rows. No future API/class or code requirement.
synchronization: Add companion GN rows without deleting old24 rows
Global Feature Matrix/coverage/independent-review finding status by parent
regression: Unknown item still maps nil; invalid move compacts; all-invalid moves still fall back to first registry move
No blanket root alias from handler identity registration
Gen5 remains optional, no recursive automatic PBS discovery
Existing GN-M06/M24 and B17 EV vectors unchanged
Normal compiler/file failure boundaries are not replaced by rollback promises
tentative.strongest_rebuttal: WP76 §8.4 already correctly states the general unknown-identifier outcomes, and §10.8 does not promise lossless default data. Therefore this is a proposed data/test coverage addition rather than a demonstrated incorrect clause. Parent should reject as a material defect if named shipped-data cases are not required for this assigned compatibility slice.
